en.summary: Recent videos open at every window width, when every download source fails the launcher shows the reason for each source, and replacing a person runs on 16 GB Macs.
changes: Creation panel: "Recent videos" can be opened at every window width; in a narrow window the list opens over the preview. The @ character menu shows each character's face close-up instead of the full-length picture. When a part length is refused, the length panel says whether it is too short or too long instead of asking to try again.

Install: when every source for a download fails, the launcher's error card lists each source with its reason and time, and the copied details and the diagnostic report include the same list. Git errors name the folder of the dependency. Account names, passwords, tokens and local paths are removed from the listed addresses.

Prompt enhancement: when the connection to FreeVideo is lost, a connection-lost message is shown instead of the browser's raw error, and a failed progress check is retried before the rewrite stops. After a rewrite, characters mentioned with @ are still shown by name in the prompt box. When the prompt or references change during a rewrite, a note asks for a new rewrite instead of an error with a report button.

Prompt enhancement: the rewrite tab shows the scene description followed by a separate "Sound:" section instead of the model's field names. With several shots, each shot is its own paragraph labelled with its number and start time. A rewrite that is not edited is submitted exactly as the model wrote it. The default prompt in a prompt box that has not been edited uses the same layout and is also submitted unchanged. A prompt filled in with "Reuse settings" or opened from a workflow saved by an earlier version also uses this layout and, when not edited, is submitted unchanged.
Editor: when the last edit can no longer be found, a blank edit opens with a message saying so; clicking the edit name at the top opens another edit.

Settings: a new AI Agent section chooses whether an agent asks before starting a film and before a long reshoot, and how many minutes make a reshoot long. Both ask by default. When an agent's white-model scene fails, the agent receives the reason instead of a generic connection error.

Install: when the NVIDIA driver is installed but not running, for example right after it was installed, the launcher's error card asks for a restart instead of showing the raw detection error. When the NVIDIA driver is missing, the card adds one line naming the graphics card Windows lists; when Windows lists only AMD or Intel graphics, the card says FreeVideo supports NVIDIA graphics cards only.
Video generation: when a generation falls back to a freshly started worker, the result is the same as in the worker that was already running.
Image generation: when Windows runs out of virtual memory while loading the image model, the failure card says so and suggests closing other apps or increasing virtual memory.

Linux: when no file manager can open a folder, the launcher and the image history show a message, and the image history also shows the images folder. The default save location follows the desktop's Documents folder. Curly apostrophes in English text are drawn at normal width instead of full width.

Mac: encoding a reference video (replace person, extending a video) needs about half the unified memory per tile, so it runs on 16 GB Macs where it stopped with a unified-memory error, including at the lowest resolution. Results are unchanged.

Mac: before installing, the launcher checks whether the disk of the chosen folder supports the file operations the Python environment needs. Without hard links the installation copies files instead; when links or renaming are not supported, a card asks for a folder on the Mac's built-in disk before anything is installed.

zh.summary: 任何窗口宽度下都能打开“最近作品”，依赖下载在所有源都失败时，启动器列出每个源的原因；16 GB 的 Mac 上也能替换人物。
changes: 创作面板：任何窗口宽度下都能打开“最近作品”；窗口较窄时，列表盖在预览上打开。输入 @ 时，角色头像改为脸部特写，不再是全身图。每段时长被拒绝时，长度面板会说明是过短还是过长，不再提示重试。
安装：依赖下载在所有源都失败时，启动器错误卡片逐个列出每个源的失败原因和耗时，复制的详情和诊断报告中也附有这份列表。Git 报错会写明对应依赖的文件夹。列出的地址会去掉账号、密码、令牌和本地路径。
提示词增强：与 FreeVideo 的连接中断时，显示连接断开的提示，而不是浏览器的原始错误；改写进度读取失败时先重试，不再立即中止。改写后，人物仍以“@人物名”显示在提示词框中。改写过程中原文或素材有改动时，显示一条提醒，请按新内容重新改写，不再显示错误和报告按钮。
提示词增强：“改写”页签只显示画面描述，下面单独列出“声音：”段，不再显示模型的字段名；有多个镜头时，每个镜头单独成段，标出镜头编号和开始时间。未修改的改写结果按模型原文提交。提示词框里未改动的默认提示词也按同样方式显示，提交时仍用原文。用“复用设置”填入的提示词和旧版本保存的工作流里的提示词同样按这种方式显示，未修改时按原文提交。
剪辑视图：上次的剪辑已找不到时，打开空白剪辑并给出说明；点击顶部的剪辑名可打开其他剪辑。
设置：新增“AI Agent”区块，可选择 Agent 在开拍整部片前、以及耗时较长的重拍前是否先询问，并设置重拍达到多少分钟算较长。两项默认都询问。Agent 搭建的白模场景失败时，Agent 收到具体原因，不再是笼统的连接错误。
安装：NVIDIA 显卡驱动已安装但未运行时（例如刚装好还未重启），启动器错误卡片提示重启电脑，不再显示原始的检测失败信息。未找到 NVIDIA 显卡驱动时，提示卡新增一行，写出系统列出的显卡；系统只列出 AMD 或 Intel 显卡时，卡片说明 FreeVideo 只支持 NVIDIA 显卡。
视频生成：生成改由新启动的进程完成时，结果与原先运行中的进程相同。
图像生成：Windows 虚拟内存不足、无法载入图像模型时，失败卡片会说明原因，并建议关闭其他程序或调大虚拟内存。
Linux：没有可用的文件管理器打开文件夹时，启动器和图片历史给出提示，图片历史同时显示图片文件夹的路径；默认保存位置跟随桌面设置的文档文件夹。英文中的弯撇号按西文宽度显示，不再显示为全角。
Mac：编码参考视频（替换人物、接着生成）时，每个瓦片所需的统一内存约减半，在 16 GB 的 Mac 上不再因统一内存不足而中止，最低分辨率下也是如此；结果不变。
Mac：安装开始前，启动器先检查所选文件夹所在磁盘是否支持 Python 运行环境所需的文件操作。不支持硬链接时改用复制继续安装；不支持链接或改名时，在安装任何内容之前提示选择 Mac 内置硬盘上的文件夹。

en.summary: An audio clip can be used as is, so the video carries that clip as its sound; a tutorial and feature examples explain each feature with an example that can be filled in directly; after a video finishes, the model stays loaded and the next video starts without reloading.
changes: Studio: audio cards offer "Reference" or "Use as is". With "Use as is", the clip is written into the video unchanged as its sound, the picture follows it, and the duration follows the clip and is locked. "Use as is" is not available with "Preview first" or when extending a video. Replace person downloads its model when it is missing.

Guides: "Tutorial" in Settings has chapters with pictures for each feature, and "Try it" fills a chapter's example into the creation panel. "Feature examples" shows each feature as a looping preview of the input and the result, with "Use this example". The examples are shown once on first use, and after an update only the new ones are shown.

Memory and speed: after a video finishes, the model stays on the graphics card and in memory with no time limit, so the next video starts without reloading. It is released when memory runs low, when another program starts using more video memory, or before the picture or prompt model starts; when memory is tight, as much of it is kept as still leaves room for the next request.

Speed: the first video of a new length or size starts sooner, because three of the model's kernels are compiled once for every length, size and head split. Requests with LoRA adapters run faster, because each adapter's input projection is computed once per layer instead of once for every group of attention heads. A slowdown switched on automatically after the app was closed or stopped unexpectedly now lifts after one completed generation instead of three; a slowdown caused by a reported GPU error still needs three.

Generation: pressing Generate with an empty prompt shows "The prompt is empty." next to the button, with "Generate anyway". In the editor, broken characters left in a description by a cut or a paste are removed before the part is sent. On a computer with several graphics cards, queued videos run at the same time, one on each card.
Workflows: a saved workflow opens ready to run when a value on its FreeVideo node is no longer accepted; that value returns to its default and the rest of the workflow is unchanged.

Creations: a video can be marked as a favorite with the heart button, and "All" and "Favorites" at the top switch between every video and favorites only; the choice is kept for the next time Creations opens.
Autopilot: a chat can be renamed with "Rename" in its menu. The name is kept after a restart, and clearing it shows the first message as the title again.

Install: on Linux, setup from the launcher downloads Git and a C++ compiler privately when they are missing instead of asking for sudo; only basic tools such as curl still come from the system, and the launcher shows the command to install them. A graphics driver older than 580 gets its notice with the detected card even when nvidia-smi cannot answer the setup query. When the system is older than 2022 or lacks the graphics libraries its window needs, the Linux desktop app shows the reason and what to do instead of closing without a message.
Updates: on every platform, update downloads can use the mirror in China, and a slow source is switched automatically, continuing the download.

Diagnostics: on Mac, a generation refused at the start for lack of free memory has its own row in the error panel, and the report records the memory at that moment. Feedback for a video in Creations that cannot be opened includes the player's error code and the file's response. Diagnostic reports record which graphics card the run used.

zh.summary: 音频可以原样使用，视频直接以这段音频为声音；新增教程和功能示例，逐项介绍功能，示例可以直接填入；视频完成后模型保留，下一条视频无需重新加载。
changes: 工作室：音频卡片可选“参考”或“原样使用”。选择“原样使用”时，这段音频原样写入视频作为声音，画面随之生成，时长跟随音频并锁定。开启“先出预览”或接着生成时，不能选择“原样使用”。替换人物缺少模型时会自动下载。
指引：设置中的“教程”按功能分章，配有图片，点“试一试”可把该章的示例填入创作面板。“功能示例”逐项以循环预览展示输入和成片，并可点“用这个示例”。首次使用时会依次展示一遍，更新后只展示新增的示例。
内存与速度：视频完成后，模型会一直保留在显卡和内存中，不再有时间限制，下一条视频无需重新加载。内存不足、其他程序占用的显存增加，或图片和提示词模型启动前，模型会被释放；内存紧张时，在保证下一次请求放得下的前提下尽量多保留。
速度：换新的时长或尺寸后，第一条视频更早开始，模型的三个内核对所有时长、尺寸和分头方式只编译一次。挂 LoRA 的请求更快，每个适配器的输入降维乘法每层只算一次，不再每个注意力头组各算一次。应用被意外关闭或结束后自动开启的放慢，完成 1 次生成就解除，不再需要 3 次；显卡报告错误引起的放慢仍需 3 次。
生成：提示词为空时点生成，按钮旁会显示“提示词为空。”，并可点“继续生成”。剪辑视图中，剪切或粘贴在描述里留下的残缺字符会在发送前去掉。有多张显卡的电脑上，排队的视频会同时生成，每张显卡一条。
工作流：另存的工作流中，FreeVideo 节点上有不再接受的取值时，打开即可运行；该取值恢复为默认值，工作流其余内容不变。
作品库：可以用心形按钮收藏视频，顶部的“全部”和“收藏”可切换显示全部视频或只显示收藏；下次打开作品库时保留所选。
AI 全自动：对话可以在菜单中“重命名”。名称在重启后保留，清空名称后重新以第一句话作为标题。
安装：Linux 上从启动器安装时，缺少 Git 和 C++ 编译器会改为私有下载，不再需要 sudo；只有 curl 等基础工具仍需系统提供，启动器会给出安装命令。即使 nvidia-smi 无法响应安装检查的查询，低于 580 的显卡驱动也会显示带检测到显卡的提示。系统早于 2022 年或缺少窗口所需的图形库时，Linux 桌面版会说明原因和处理办法，不再无提示地退出。
更新：所有平台的更新下载都可走国内镜像，下载源过慢时自动换源续传。
诊断：Mac 上因可用内存不足而在开始前被拒绝的生成，在错误面板中单独一行说明，报告会记录当时的内存。作品库中视频打不开时，反馈会附上播放器错误码和文件响应。诊断报告会记录这次运行使用的显卡。

en.summary: A person in a source video can be replaced with the character in a person image; reference videos can be used for depth only; the built-in AI sets up a white-model scene from one sentence; an earlier video's prompt and settings can be reused; decoding on cards with less video memory is quicker.
changes: Studio: "Replace person" in the Media section replaces the person in a source video with the character in a person image, and can keep the source video's sound; if that sound cannot be added, the finished video is still kept. A reference video can be set to "Depth only"; its depth is computed once and reused by later requests.

Creation panel: after an earlier video is selected in Recent videos, "Reuse settings" fills its prompt, picture size and duration back into the panel; "Undo" restores the previous values within 10 seconds.

White models: when no external Agent is connected, the white-model button in the chat box works with the built-in AI. Describe the shot in one sentence; if a ready-made scene fits, a white model is generated for confirmation, otherwise the reason is shown and the sentence is kept.

Long videos: when a description is split across parts, the story is no longer repeated in every part; the shared text keeps only what stays the same, such as people, place, lighting and style. Without the prompt model, the description is split across the parts by sentence instead of every part using the whole description, and the creation panel offers to download the prompt model; a download in progress is paused when generation starts.

Editor: a continued part can be as short as 5 seconds, and on Mac and on computers that cannot make 10 seconds at once a new part starts at 5 seconds; a video with a continued part shorter than 10 seconds has at most 4 parts. A description over the length limit is pointed out before sending, including on a retry.

Generation: after other ComfyUI workflows have run, the video memory they hold is released before a picture or a prompt rewrite starts, without restarting ComfyUI. A missing text encoder model is detected before encoding starts, with repair guidance; if a model repair fails while downloading, the original file is restored. When generation cannot start because the installation is in use, the failure details name the programs holding it open. When the GPU checks before switching to int8 fail, the failure card lists the reason for each check.

Memory and speed: on graphics cards that cannot hold the whole decoder, decoding no longer prepares the same layers again for every video segment or every new request while memory allows, with identical output. On most Windows graphics cards with 8 to 12 GB of video memory, the first pass of two-pass videos between 10 and 12 seconds without LoRA computes 8 attention heads at a time instead of 4, as shorter videos already did. On Windows, when other programs free video memory during a generation, the next pass and decoding use the recovered memory.

Install: setup no longer stops with a dependency mismatch after the installation folder was moved, copied or restored, and a dependency folder too deep for Windows is reported as a long path. Text encoder and tokenizer files deleted after installation are restored from the local copy before encoding and during repair, without downloading.
Phone access: the phone page works when local network access is switched on in the launcher, and no longer shows "Connection lost. Reconnecting..." with no content.

Agents: the install-skill command installs the FreeVideo skill for an Agent, also from deeply nested Windows folders. The tool list an Agent receives is shorter: common tools are listed in full and the others are opened through a help tool.
Diagnostic reports: when ComfyUI restarts during a generation, the report of that run is marked as interrupted instead of running, and a long video keeps the report of the part that was interrupted.

zh.summary: 可以用人物图中的角色替换源视频里的人物；参考视频可以仅参考深度；内置 AI 可以用一句话搭出白模场景；可以复用之前视频的提示词和设置；显存较小的显卡解码更快。
changes: 工作室：“素材”一栏新增“替换人物”，用人物图中的角色替换源视频里的人物，可选保留源视频的声音；声音未能加入时，生成的视频仍会保留。参考视频可以勾选“仅参考深度”，深度只计算一次，之后的请求直接复用。
创作面板：在“最近作品”中选中之前的视频后，点“复用设置”可以把它的提示词、画面尺寸和时长填回面板；10 秒内点“撤销”可以恢复原来的内容。
白模：未连接外部 Agent 时，聊天框的白模按钮也可以使用。用一句话描述镜头，有合适的现成场景就先生成白模供确认，没有则说明原因并保留输入。
长视频：描述分到各段时，不再在每一段重复整个故事，各段共用的部分只保留人物、场景、光线和风格等不变的内容。未安装提示词模型时，描述按句子顺序分到各段，不再每段都用整段描述，创作面板会提示下载提示词模型；开始生成时，正在进行的下载会暂停。
剪辑视图：接着生成的每段最短可以是 5 秒，在 Mac 和无法一次生成 10 秒的电脑上，新的一段默认 5 秒；含短于 10 秒的接续段时，一个视频最多 4 段。描述超过长度上限时，发送前（包括重试时）就会提示。
生成：在 ComfyUI 里跑过其他工作流之后，生成图片和改写提示词前会先释放这些工作流占用的显存，无需重启 ComfyUI。文本编码器模型缺失时，会在编码开始前检测并给出修复指引；模型修复在下载中失败时，会还原原来的文件。安装正被占用而无法开始生成时，失败详情会写出占用它的程序。切换到 int8 前的 GPU 检查失败时，错误卡片会列出每项检查的失败原因。
内存与速度：显存放不下整个解码器的显卡，在内存允许时解码不再为每个视频片段或每次新请求重复准备同样的层，输出不变。显存 8–12 GB 的大多数 Windows 显卡上，10–12 秒、不带 LoRA 的两遍视频，第一遍每次计算的注意力头由 4 个增加到 8 个，与更短的视频相同。Windows 上，生成过程中其他程序释放显存后，下一遍和解码会用上恢复的显存。
安装：安装目录被移动、复制或还原后，安装不再因依赖不一致而停下；依赖目录层级过深时会按长路径问题提示。安装后被删掉的文本编码器和分词器文件，会在编码前和修复时从本地副本还原，不需要下载。
手机访问：在启动器里打开局域网访问后，手机页可以正常使用，不再一直显示“连接断了，正在重新连接…”且没有内容。
Agent：install-skill 命令可以为 Agent 安装 FreeVideo 技能，Windows 上层级很深的目录也能装。Agent 拿到的工具列表更短：常用工具完整列出，其余工具通过帮助工具打开。
诊断报告：生成过程中 ComfyUI 重启后，这次运行的报告会标为已中断，不再显示为运行中；长视频会保留被中断那一段的报告。

en.summary: Each part planned in the editor can have its own description; low-memory generations explain why they are slower.
changes: Generation: When a generation runs in low-memory mode, the progress view says why it is slower.

Editor: Each part of a video planned in the editor can now have its own description, and a continued part uses exactly what you write for it. The highlight on characters mentioned with @ in the prompt box updates as soon as a rewritten prompt is filled in.

zh.summary: 剪辑里规划的每一段可以单独写描述；低显存模式下的生成会说明较慢的原因。
changes: 生成：低显存模式下，进度区会说明这次生成较慢的原因。
剪辑视图：剪辑里规划的每一段现在都可以单独写描述，接着生成的一段会用为它写的描述。改写后的提示词填回时，@人物 高亮立即刷新。

en.summary: Autopilot chat can attach reference pictures; the launcher and the editor explain more precisely why a step failed; Mac setup no longer needs Git installed.
changes: Autopilot: a chat message can carry reference pictures, added with the Picture button, by pasting or by dragging, up to 4 per message and 10 MB each. A picture that fails to upload stays in place and can be clicked to retry.

Launcher and setup: choosing a folder inside a portable ComfyUI, such as its python_embeded folder, now names the portable folder to select. Mac setup downloads its own Git when the system has none. A failed Git download no longer leaves an incomplete folder behind, and leftovers from earlier attempts are removed. On Windows, when security software briefly holds the newly downloaded installer tool, setup retries for a few seconds instead of stopping with "This folder is not writable".

Edit: a failed save now states its cause, and a lost connection is reported as a lost connection. Edit also works on an https page served through a proxy that terminates the secure connection, as on some cloud GPU hosts.

Diagnostic reports: the page check states why an open creative panel cannot be seen. When a request is refused for lack of memory on Windows, the report records how much of the used memory FreeVideo itself holds.

zh.summary: AI 全自动聊天可以附参考图；启动器和编辑器更准确地说明失败原因；Mac 安装不再需要预先装好 Git。
changes: AI 全自动：聊天消息可以附参考图，用“图片”按钮、粘贴或拖入添加，每条最多 4 张、每张不超过 10 MB。上传失败的图片会保留，点击即可重试。
启动器和安装：选中便携版 ComfyUI 内部的文件夹（例如 python_embeded）时，提示会写出应选择的便携版文件夹。Mac 系统没有 Git 时，安装会自行下载 Git。Git 下载失败后不再留下不完整的文件夹，以前残留的也会清除。Windows 上安全软件短暂占用刚下载的安装工具时，安装会重试数秒，不再以“此文件夹不可写”停止。
编辑：保存失败时会写明原因，连接断开时显示为连接已断开。通过代理终止安全连接的 https 页面（部分云端显卡主机即是如此）上也可以正常使用编辑。
诊断报告：页面检查会写明创作面板已打开却看不到的原因。Windows 上请求因内存不足被拒绝时，报告会写出已用内存中 FreeVideo 自己占用多少。

en.summary: Agent image tasks can place characters in a scene by position, size and facing; the page check no longer reports a covered toolbar behind ComfyUI dialogs.
changes: Agent images: an image task can take a scene picture and one to three characters (character card or picture) with a position, a height, a full-body or half-body framing and a facing direction. The picture is generated with the scene as the first reference instead of a pasted collage, and the result can be used directly as a first frame.

Page check: the FreeVideo toolbar is no longer reported as covered when ComfyUI shows a dimming or click-away layer over it, such as the Templates dialog on a first start or the Help panel; the details now name what covers the toolbar.

zh.summary: Agent 图片任务可按位置、大小和朝向把人物放进场景；页面检查不再因 ComfyUI 的对话框遮罩报告工具栏被遮挡。
changes: Agent 图片：图片任务可以指定一张场景图和一至三个人物（角色卡或图片），并设定位置、人物高度、全身或半身景别和朝向。图片以场景为第一参考图生成，不再拼贴粘图，结果可直接作首帧。
页面检查：ComfyUI 的调暗或点击遮罩（首次启动的模板对话框、帮助面板等）盖在 FreeVideo 工具栏上时，不再报告工具栏被遮挡；诊断详情会写出遮挡工具栏的元素。

en.summary: One continuous shot can now be split into up to 8 parts; generated pictures can be downloaded directly and the path of a video can be copied.
changes: Long videos: one continuous shot can now be split into up to 8 parts instead of 5. The line below the duration in the creation panel states that each run makes one continuous shot and points to Edit or Autopilot for a storyboard; a length that needs more parts than allowed is stopped before it is submitted, and a refusal at submission is shown as a plain notice instead of an unknown error.
Reference video: fixed generation failing when a reference video is combined with a non-default upscale factor such as 1.5x.
Pictures and videos: picture cards in the Autopilot chat and the enlarged picture view have a Download button; results in the library and the creation panel have Copy path.
The desktop notification for a finished generation is now on by default: permission is requested once, the first time Generate is clicked; it stays off for anyone who has turned it off.

Edit: while the generation service has not answered, the generation bar stays visible with Generate dimmed; when the automatic checks get no answer, the status line shows "Generation unavailable" with a retry link, which checks again when clicked.
The edits, imports, characters, Agent conversations and Agent jobs lists now end with a line such as "N edits could not be read" when some records cannot be read.

Windows graphics cards with 8 to 12 GB of video memory: the first pass of FP8 two-pass videos on RTX 40 and 50 series cards, and the second pass of int8 videos longer than 10 seconds on 12 GB cards, now run attention 8 heads at a time instead of 4, within the planned memory budget. LoRA, Linux and Mac are unchanged. The same seed can give a slightly different video.

Retry after one-time errors: a second pass that stops with a one-time CUDA error resumes once from the finished first pass instead of failing or repeating it; on a Mac, a pass that stops with a Metal command-buffer error is retried once with smaller memory partitions. Failure reports name the machine, settings and retry result, and report ids stay retrievable after the service restarts.
Decoding the same request with the same seed now writes identical pixels every time. Compared with earlier versions, the same seed can give slightly different pixels.

The card shown for an unsupported graphics card now names the detected card and its compute capability, and states that FreeVideo needs compute capability 8.0 or higher (GeForce RTX 30 series or newer) regardless of VRAM. Error text no longer replaces a slash inside a sentence with a path placeholder.

zh.summary: 一个连续镜头最多可分 8 段；生成的图片可以直接下载，作品可以复制路径。
changes: 长视频：一个连续镜头最多可分 8 段（原为 5 段）。创作面板时长下方写明每次生成一个连续镜头，有分镜剧本时可转到剪辑视图或 AI 全自动；所需段数超过上限时在提交前提示缩短时长，提交时仍被拒绝也显示为普通提示，不再显示为未知错误。
参考视频：修复参考视频配合 1.5 倍等非默认放大倍数时生成失败。
图片和作品：AI 全自动对话中的图片卡和放大查看窗增加“下载”；作品库和创作面板的结果按钮增加“复制路径”。
生成完成的桌面通知改为默认开启：第一次点生成时请求一次通知权限；已经关闭通知的保持关闭。
剪辑视图：生成服务暂时没有回答时，生成栏不再被藏起，“生成”按钮置灰；几次自动检查都没有回答时，状态行显示“生成服务暂不可用 · 重试”，点击后重新检查。
剪辑、已导入、角色、Agent 对话和 Agent 任务列表中有记录无法读取时，列表末尾写明“另有 N 个……无法读取”。
Windows 上显存 8–12 GB 的显卡：RTX 40 和 50 系列 FP8 两遍视频的第一遍，以及 12 GB 显卡上超过 10 秒的 int8 视频的第二遍，每次计算的注意力头由 4 个增加到 8 个，显存占用保持在计划预算内。LoRA、Linux 和 Mac 不变。同一个种子生成的视频可能略有不同。
一次性错误自动重试：第二遍遇到一次性的 CUDA 错误时，自动从已完成的第一遍续跑一次，不再整个请求失败或重做第一遍；Mac 上采样阶段遇到 Metal 命令缓冲区错误时，会用更小的内存分块重试一次。失败报告写明机器、设置和重试结果，报告编号在服务重启后仍可取回。
同一请求、同一种子，解码出的画面每次逐位一致。与之前的版本相比，同一种子的画面可能有细微差别。
不受支持的显卡的提示卡现在写出检测到的显卡和计算能力，并说明 FreeVideo 需要计算能力 8.0 及以上的显卡（GeForce RTX 30 系列及更新），与显存大小无关。错误文字中句子里的斜杠不再被替换成路径占位符。

en.summary: Several pictures can be deleted from the image history at once; prompt enhancement states the reason when it cannot finish.
changes: Install: setup no longer stops when some graphics card details cannot be read; command-line generation works on Windows when FreeVideo is installed in a very deep folder.
Image history: after Select, several pictures can be checked and deleted at once, with a second click to confirm; pictures that are in use or cannot be deleted stay in place with the reason shown.
Prompt enhancement: when enhancement cannot finish and the original prompt is used, the reason is shown; a rewrite that lacks the video or audio description is sent back to the model to add it.

Editor: Extend on a finished video without a description asks for a description first instead of showing an English validation error; when the description box is cleared, the description carried over for that segment is used.
The Linux package now includes curl, so installation and downloads work on systems without it.
Download list: the check no longer hashes every model file again each time it runs; files already hashed are skipped while their size, times and inode are unchanged.
Keeps the failed phase, step count, error type and memory readings of a GPU error that raised the compatibility level, so a diagnostic report sent after a later run still shows where it stopped.
The chat no longer shows the notice for an edited waiting message as an error with a report button; it is a plain status line.

zh.summary: 生图历史可以一次删除多张；提示词增强未能完成时写明原因。
changes: 安装：部分显卡信息读不到时，安装不再中断；Windows 上 FreeVideo 安装在很深的文件夹时，命令行生成可以正常运行。
生图历史：点“选择”后可以勾选多张一次删除，删除前需要再次确认；被占用或无法删除的图片会保留并写明原因。
提示词增强：增强未能完成、改用原提示词时，写明原因；改写结果缺少视频或音频描述时，会请模型补上。
剪辑页：在没有描述的成片后“接着生成”时，会提示先写一句描述，不再显示英文校验错误；描述框被清空时，沿用这一段原有的描述。
Linux 安装包自带 curl，系统未安装 curl 时也能正常安装和下载。
下载清单：检查不再每次重新校验所有模型文件；已经校验过的文件在大小、时间和 inode 都没变时直接跳过。
保留导致兼容档位升高的显卡错误的出错阶段、步数、错误类型和内存读数，之后一次运行发送的诊断报告仍能看出它停在哪里。
对话中修改了正在等待 Agent 的消息后，提示不再按错误显示、不再带“报告问题”按钮，改为普通状态提示。
